name: POST /api/leadflow/failures - record a failure and take its fallback
description:
Records one of the six documented failure modes and returns its fallback and NAMED OWNER (4cc3f597-f6c8-4dc5-8044-096ce144e676#AC1). The owner is the part that is easy to leave out and the part that decides whether anything happens: an alert addressed to everybody is addressed to nobody.

THE SIX MODES ARE A CLOSED SET, enforced by a CHECK constraint. A free string would let a new failure be logged under a name nothing has a fallback for, which is the same as not logging it - MEASURED LIVE, an unknown mode was refused with all six named.

THE ORIGINAL EVENT ID IS MANDATORY AND IS THE DEDUPE KEY. A connector outage that loses it makes the backfill produce duplicates, because nothing can tell which events already landed, so it is part of a unique constraint rather than a field somebody remembers to populate. A repeat report of the same failure returns 200 with duplicate true and writes nothing.

RETRIES ARE PART OF THE RUNBOOK ENTRY, not a transport setting: "retry safely once with no duplicate" is a product decision about a customer's inbox, and burying it in an HTTP client's config is how it silently becomes three.

testCases.name: A documented failure is recorded with its fallback and owner
NEGATIVE: a failure mode nothing has a fallback for
NEGATIVE: no original event id, so the backfill could not deduplicate
NEGATIVE: no Authorization header at all
NEGATIVE: a bearer token that does not verify

errorCases.message: failure_mode must be one of connector_down, provider_send_failure, calendar_sync_failure, payment_webhook_missing, duplicate_send_loop, timezone_or_holiday_rule - a failure logged under a name nothing has a fallback for is the same as not logging it
errorCases.when: the mode is outside the six documented ones, or original_event_id is absent.

errorCases.message: Authorization header with a bearer token is required
errorCases.when: the Authorization header is absent, empty, or uses a scheme other than Bearer.

errorCases.message: Session token is invalid or expired
errorCases.when: a Bearer token was presented but does not verify.
